definitions.name: O2D.MOD
definitions.body: 'B' BIND 'A' BIND A A B DIV FLOOR B MUL SUB
definitions.note: a b to the remainder a - b*floor(a/b)

definitions.name: O2D.ABS
definitions.note: absolute value of a number, element-wise over a Vector

definitions.name: O2D.MINV
definitions.note: smallest element of a non-empty Vector of numbers or Strings

definitions.name: O2D.BYKEY
definitions.body: ZIP [ 'N' 'A' ] BIND N A GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of [ key amount ] pairs to a Record from each key to the sum of its amounts, keys in order of first appearance

definitions.name: O2D.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE [ 'D' BIND N D O2D.MOD 0 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer to its positive divisors, ascending

definitions.name: O2D.ISPRIME
definitions.note: TRUE when a positive integer is prime

definitions.name: O2D.PRIMES
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 0 N RANGE [ 1 GT ] FILTER [ O2D.ISPRIME ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer to the primes at most it, ascending (empty for 1)

definitions.name: O2D.BINARY
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 0 5 RANGE 'KS' BIND KS [ 'K' BIND N 2 K POW DIV FLOOR 2 O2D.MOD ] MAP KS [ 'K' BIND 2 K POW N GT NOT ] FILTER LENGTH TAKE REVERSE STR JOIN
definitions.note: integer from 1 to 63 to its base-2 String without leading zeros

definitions.name: O2D.CSTEP
definitions.body: 'IG' BIND [ 'C' 'S' ] BIND C 2 DIV C 3 MUL 1 ADD C 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL C EQ SELECT 'NX' BIND C 1 EQ 'DONE' BIND 1 NX DONE SELECT S S 1 ADD DONE SELECT 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step over [ current steps ] ignoring the element: one Collatz move and steps+1, or unchanged once current is 1

definitions.name: O2D.COLLATZ
definitions.body: 0 2 COLLECT 'A' BIND 1 120 RANGE A [ O2D.CSTEP ] FOLD 1 GET
definitions.note: positive integer up to 60 to the number of Collatz steps down to 1 (at most 120 moves are simulated)

definitions.name: O2D.FIBSTEP
definitions.body: 'IG' BIND [ 'A' 'B' ] BIND B A B ADD 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: SCAN step over [ F(k) F(k+1) ] ignoring the element: the next Fibonacci pair

definitions.name: O2D.FIBS
definitions.body: 1 20 RANGE 0 1 2 COLLECT [ O2D.FIBSTEP ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: the first 20 Fibonacci numbers F(1)..F(20), starting 1 1 2 3 5

definitions.name: O2D.ORDERS
definitions.note: JSON String with an "orders" array to its Vector of order Records

definitions.name: O2D.PRICED
definitions.note: JSON orders String to the order Records that have a price

definitions.name: O2D.REVENUE
definitions.body: O2D.PRICED [ 'O' BIND O 'qty' GET O 'price' GET MUL ] MAP G0A.SUM
definitions.note: JSON orders String to the total of qty times price over the priced orders

definitions.name: O2D.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'L' BIND S L 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S L 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty Vector of numbers (mean of the two middle values when the count is even)

definitions.name: O2D.DEVS
definitions.note: each number minus the mean of the Vector, in order

definitions.name: O2D.VAR
definitions.body: O2D.DEVS 'D' BIND D D MUL G0A.MEAN
definitions.note: population variance of a Vector of numbers
